note: Quantities the manuscript cites that are derived from the pipeline but appear inside no results/ file. Regenerate with `make facts`. atlas.check_manuscript_numbers compares the manuscript's stated guardrail count against guardrail_tests_collected rather than looking it up in the value pool: both 102 and 118 -- the counts this manuscript carried before -- match exactly one unrelated pipeline value each, so a stale count would be reported as verified. How many tests PASS depends on the checkout (a release archive ships data/ and results/, a git archive does not), so the passing count must be measured from the release at release time.
archive_measured_for_version: the v2.4.4 release archive, measured as a reader sees it: the submission-package checks need the author's own deliverables and skip without them, so the count does not depend on whose machine runs it. Measured on 2026-09-09 with HOME pointed at an empty directory. v2.4.4 changes a manifest note and a docstring only, so the counts are unchanged from v2.4.3, which was measured the same way from the deposited archive at 10.5281/zenodo.22637468: 179 passed, 23 skipped, 202 collected
bare_clone_measured_for: a fresh clone of main, independent virtualenv on Python 3.12.13, HOME pointed at an empty directory: 130 passed, 72 skipped; results/, data/ and the package absent. Measured on 2026-09-09 at a662470, the first commit past the v2.4.3 deposit
